en: Black‑and‑white view over a landscaped park with curving paths and sparse trees in the foreground, facing a row of ornate multi‑storey late‑19th‑century buildings and hotels at the foot of a wooded hill. A small church or chapel stands on the slope. Along the lower border of the image is a black strip with hand‑written white text that appears mirrored, including a word resembling a place name and a number.
